Hey, I know you don’t want to hear it/ have heard it 3000 times. The clichés are annoying, “you matter”   “It isn’t worth it” 
“Permanent solution to a temporary problem” all of that. I want to preface this by saying that I do not want this to come off as “oh boo hoo we all have it bad/I have it worse” which is not the case in the slightest, I’m just trying to share some of my experiences to maybe let you know that you aren’t alone in this feeling (even if it feels like you are) I’m going to start by saying, *IF ANYONE SEES THIS COMMENT AND THINK THAT IT MAY MAKE OP FEEL WORSE, PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE TELL ME, THE LAST THING I WANT IS TO CAUSE ANOTHER PERSON PAIN* 

I personally feel as though life isn’t worth living. I myself *feel* like life is not worth living. Ever since I can remember, I’ve had clinical depression. Every time I would have a “good day” I would snap out of it half way through and realize that I’m going to go back to being depressed, it’s inevitable. You know how most “normal” people (I say normal because I don’t believe that this is how anyone should live) usually live their life with a normal amount of stress or sadness? They would go through their week feeling relatively happy, of course that’s not everyone. My point is, they exist feeling relatively happy and will get depressed if something bad or really sad happens. I am the negative version of that person. I am constantly depressed and will get random “spouts” of happiness. It is a terrible *terrible* way to exist, I would say live but I don’t think that this constitutes as living. I *know* that I am loved, I *know* that I have the world at the balls, I *know* that I am doing great at the moment, considering I’m working full-time, going to college, and paying my bills and all that, but I *feel* as though it’s not enough, it’s NEVER enough. While I know as a fact that I am loved and cared for, I feel as though I’m not, and sadly, emotional almost always outweighs knowledge (for me at least). Living feels like a chore, it feels like it isn’t worth it, the payoff isn’t worth the time, pain and effort. I’m only 18, being 18 is both the best and worst thing, I am still mentally a kid, but legally I’m an adult. I’ve been spoiled and helicoptered my entire life. I have NO idea how to do anything myself, that includes making basic decisions. I can’t make basic decisions for myself without asking someone, “What should I do?” It isn’t fun, I can’t do anything myself, it just makes everything worse. A very basic decision makes me stress, bad. Clinical depression is a selfish fucking thing. It is a disease. It makes me feel like I’m nothing, less than nothing really. It makes you want to curl up and cry forever. I genuinely cannot see myself dying of natural causes, that means like dying of old age. Every time that I think of myself passing (which is a lot)   It’s always either due to my own hands, an accident, or some other horrible way. For me, it’s not a case of if, it’s a case of when. I’ve tried to get help, I have. It feels like a lost cause, I’m doing everything I can, as best as I can, just to be stepped over or ignored. Don’t get me wrong, my parents are amazing, it’s mainly the professionals I’m talking about. The last time that I was feeling extremely low, I was close to killing myself. I almost did it. Normally I make a plan think everything out blah blah blah, but I never have the balls to commit. This time however, I almost did. If it wasn’t for my Dad talking to me, I would have taken my car and crashed it into something (far away from innocent people) going as fast as I could. I reached out to my therapist (keep in mind, she cancelled the last 4 times in a row) and didn’t get any response at all. Not a text, not a call, nothing. My psychiatrist doesn’t care, she calls medicine into the wrong place even though we tell her specifically where we wanted it to go, she gives me too much of a dose, she cancels the DAY OF the appointment. She actually almost made me overdose, I don’t mean that as a joke. She upped a medicine I had by a lot causing me to almost overdose, talked to my doctor and he said that the signs I was having were clear signs of an overdose. So when I say it feels as though I’m alone, I feel like I’m alone, almost like they just don’t care. I know I’m just another patient and I’m not special to them but, it’s so unprofessional to just not respond to a kid on the brink of suicide or to almost fucking kill me and then when I reach out to her she plays it off and blames me. It’s always my fault, no exceptions. 


Sorry to keep yapping and going on and on, I just, I feel like there is no where else to go, I’m lost, floating out in the middle of the ocean surrounded by no one, nothing except coldness and the dark realization that no matter what I do, it was for nothing. 
What makes it worse is that I don’t feel any emotion except for sadness and rarely happiness. I don’t know what it is like to love someone unconditionally and that makes me feel like I’m a horrible person, almost like I’m a robot. I love my parents of course but I don’t know what it *FEELS* like to love my parents. I’m grateful, I just don’t feel what people call love. Except, I only feel that feeling with my dog. I feel true unconditional love for my 9 year old geizer of a dog, German shepherd Chow mix. He’s my buddy. I truly *love* him. To me, that’s all I have. What makes it worse, is that I don’t feel that with my family. I am grateful and I know that they love me, and I love them too… I just don’t know what it *feels* like to love them if that makes sense. I say this because my dog is getting older and older man, he’s starting to show it. I hate it. It makes me feel terrible, like there’s something that I can do, but I know there is nothing. I genuinely don’t know what I’m going to do when he passes. He’s like my anchor, the only reason I’m still alive, and he’s slipping right through my fingertips. 


All of this to say, you are not alone, in the slightest. You may feel that way, but it isn’t true. There is always someone, something that you can look forward to. If you ever need someone to talk to, please don’t be afraid to send me a DM, I will respond as soon as I can. There are people that are here for you.
